dimension_description: This roughness scale treats surface roughness as a characteristic amplitude, usually comparable to an Ra-style average roughness. It connects optical polishing, semiconductor surfaces, paper, skin, machined parts, and construction materials. Surface texture is method-dependent, so the labels and notes matter here more than for simpler geometric scales.
